item.title: The recurring dream of replacing developers
item.description:
📝 2025, By Stephan Schwab Every decade brings new promises: this time, we'll finally make software development simple enough that we won't need so many developers. Developers feel misunderstood and undervalued. Understanding why this cycle persists for fifty years reveals what both sides need to know about the nature of software work.
🔗 Read more: https://www.caimito.net/en/blog/2025/12/07/the-recurring-dream-of-replacing-developers.html

item.title: The thing that brought me joy

item.description:
